title: H-FedSN: Personalized Sparse Networks for Efficient and Accurate Hierarchical Federated Learning for IoT Applications
abstract: arXiv:2412.06210v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT), federated learning (FL) has gained increasing attention for its privacy-preserving use of distributed data. However, conventional two-tier FL architectures are poorly suited to the hierarchical and heterogeneous nature of real-world IoT systems. Hierarchical Federated Learning (HFL) introduces multi-layer aggregation to better match IoT environments, but still suffers from communication inefficiencies and performance limitations caused by large data transfers, non-IID data distributions, and uneven device participation. These challenges hinder the realization of low-latency and high-accuracy training in practical IoT deployments. To address these limitations, we propose H-FedSN for practical IoT environments. translated_title: H-FedSN：面向物联网应用的高效且准确的分层联邦学习的个性化稀疏网络
translated_abstract: 随着物联网的快速发展，联邦学习因其对分布式数据的隐私保护利用而受到越来越多的关注。然而，传统的两层联邦学习架构难以适应现实世界物联网系统的分层和异构特性。分层联邦学习引入了多层聚合机制以更好地匹配物联网环境，但仍然受到大数据传输、非独立同分布数据分布以及设备参与不均衡所导致的通信效率低下和性能限制的影响。这些挑战阻碍了在实际物联网部署中实现低延迟和高精度的训练。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了面向实际物联网环境的H-FedSN。H-FedSN利用带有共享层和个性化层的二进制掩码机制，通过构建稀疏网络来减少通信开销，同时不改变原始的权重……
tldr: H-FedSN通过带有共享层和个性化层的二进制掩码机制构建稀疏网络，降低了分层联邦学习在物联网环境中的通信开销，并有效应对非独立同分布数据分布和设备参与不均衡等挑战，实现低延迟、高精度的训练。
en_tdlr: H-FedSN leverages a binary mask mechanism with shared and personalized layers to build sparse networks, reducing communication overhead in hierarchical federated learning for IoT applications while addressing non-IID data and uneven device participation for low-latency, high-accuracy training.
